prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-70916 for Eastgate Clinics
prose.body:
Hi Eastgate Clinics team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-70916 for 454.52 USDC. We noticed it hasn’t been settled yet, so we wanted to check in to see if you had any questions or if the payment just slipped through the cracks.

If you’re ready to process it, please send the funds to our standard settlement wallet: 0xc2a1d664efafa0c5bedbdbf4b2aa7142798061ac. As always, this is the same address we use for our regular billing cycles, so you can trust it’s the correct destination.

Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, our system will automatically update your account status and send a receipt to your billing contact. If you’ve already paid, please disregard this email.

Let us know if you need an updated copy of the invoice or if there’s anything else we can help with. We appreciate your partnership!

Best regards,
Billing Team
Yarrow Security
